summary.text: Amanda Matchett is the Democratic candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 32A, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Nolan West (R).
An attorney and technology company executive who also teaches contract law, she says she is focused on affordability and strong communities.

paragraphs.text: Amanda Matchett graduated from George Washington Senior High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Iowa State University in 2008 and a law degree from Michigan State University College of Law in 2011, and completed a graduate degree at Northwestern University's Kellogg School of Management in 2025.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Matchett said she serves as Vice President of Legal for a growing technology company, teaches contract law and mentors future attorneys.
She wrote that she lives in Blaine with her husband and family.
Matchett named housing, health care, child care, groceries and property taxes as affordability concerns, and listed public schools, safe neighborhoods and infrastructure among her priorities.
